major_cooldowns.name: Invoke Niuzao, the Black Ox
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Send it on cooldown whenever at least 25 seconds of combat remain, then feed Blackout Kick for Stomps and, as Shado-Pan, cycle Keg Smash and Breath of Fire for the whole 25 second window.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Efficient Training (Shado-Pan) cuts the cooldown to 95s; 120s is the base value from the ability table.

major_cooldowns.name: Exploding Keg
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Throw it early in a pull for the burst and the free Keg Smash reset, holding it until Keg Smash is under one charge, with Rushing Jade Wind already ticking when you have it talented.

major_cooldowns.name: Touch of Death
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Snipe it the moment the target's current health drops under your own maximum health for triple damage, otherwise take the guaranteed cast under 15% with Improved Touch of Death.

major_cooldowns.name: Black Ox Brew
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it off the global cooldown when Celestial Brew or Celestial Infusion is under one charge and your Energy and Purifying Brew charges are low enough that the refill is not wasted.

defensives.name: Fortifying Brew
defensives.usage_rule: Drink it ahead of a known spike; Keg Smash and Tiger Palm cut the 6 minute cooldown roughly in half in sustained combat, so using it beats banking it.
defensives.id_note: 115203 is the cast id; 120954 is the buff aura seen in the sampled parse.

defensives.name: Celestial Infusion
defensives.usage_rule: Absorb 30% of incoming damage, and when you are not holding it for a spike drink it at two charges or near full health for the free Empty Barrel.

defensives.name: Celestial Brew
defensives.usage_rule: The flat-absorb alternative to Celestial Infusion: never let it sit at two charges, since your rotation is constantly refunding its cooldown.
defensives.id_note: Name-verified cast id; the sampled parse ran Celestial Infusion instead of this choice node.

defensives.name: Purifying Brew
defensives.usage_rule: Play it as a one charge ability: bank one charge for Elevated Stagger and spend the other just before the second recharges, purifying as close to the hit as possible.

defensives.name: Expel Harm
defensives.usage_rule: Sweep up Healing Spheres with it once at least 3 are banked and you are dropping low or about to eat a big hit.

rules.description: Shuffle stays up for the whole fight
rules.action: Hold 100% Shuffle uptime. Keg Smash gives 5 seconds, Blackout Kick 3, Spinning Crane Kick up to 4, and it extends to a 15 second cap, so never let the rotation stall.

rules.description: Consume Blackout Combo with Tiger Palm
rules.action: Spend almost every Blackout Combo on Tiger Palm for the 100% damage buff. Comboing Keg Smash instead is only worth it when you are desperate for a Purifying Brew charge that is seconds away.

rules.description: Spend Empty Barrel on the next Keg Smash
rules.action: You can only hold 1 Empty Barrel, so cast Keg Smash as soon as one appears; that cast is free and resets Keg Smash again through Bring Me Another.
Follow every Exploding Keg with Keg Smash inside the damage window: the keg resets one Keg Smash charge and that cast feeds Fuel on the Fire and Flurry Strikes.

rules.description: Keg Smash opener into Exploding Keg and Niuzao
rules.action: Open Keg Smash, Blackout Kick, Breath of Fire, Tiger Palm, then Exploding Keg and Invoke Niuzao in either order. Establish Shuffle first; pre-pull Breath of Fire at 3 seconds and Chi Burst at 1 second.

rules.description: Tiger Palm never starves Keg Smash
rules.action: Only fill with Tiger Palm above roughly 50 Energy so the 40 Energy for the next Keg Smash is always there. Keg Smash on cooldown is your damage, your Brew cooldown reduction and your Shuffle.

source_summary: Brewmaster runs a priority rotation built around Blackout Kick every 4 seconds plus three filler globals, with Keg Smash on cooldown as the engine that pays for Shuffle and reduces every Brew cooldown. Exploding Keg and Invoke Niuzao are the offensive cooldowns, thrown early in a pull and then sent on cooldown, with Touch of Death sniped when the target's health drops under your maximum. Defensively you pretend Purifying Brew has one charge, bank the other for Elevated Stagger, keep Celestial Brew or Celestial Infusion moving rather than capped, and spend Fortifying Brew freely since the rotation halves its 6 minute cooldown.
